main.description: A predicate definition (a Ricardian 'contract'): the human sentence + subject type + eligibility rule that makes an attestation count. The set of contracts IS the ontology — the values document (we value contribution). A curated core lives under Build Guild; anyone may publish their own contracts for others to attest against (credible exit). Written to the publisher's repo.

prose.description: The human-readable assertion an attester is answering.

eligibility.description: Who has standing to answer — all reduce to 'are you named in the relevant anchor?'
